summary: Barclays PLC furnished a Form 6-K disclosing routine PDMR share dealings: Group Co-COO Craig Bright disposed 3,000 ordinary shares at 4.937 pence each on the London Stock Exchange on September 11, 2026, through Computershare as nominee administrator, and Group Chief Risk Officer Taalib Shaah received a SAYE option over 2,612 shares at 4.18 pence. No board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are present. These are standard UK MAR Article 19 notifications, with no stake change, deal terms, regulatory clock, or risk-arb angle to monitor.
